title: File Preview
summary: Accessible Smart projection of the ordinary File Preview row.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

file-name.description: The file's name, shown as the title of the row and used as its accessible name and as the download's file name.

file-size.description: The file's size: a number of bytes (2457600), drawn in the page's language and units by the core's size format (2,3 МБ; decision C25) and said with the unit as a word (2,3 мегабайта; C51); text a host already wrote (12 KB) is drawn as written.

icon.description: The glyph in the holder when no picture is shown (a Material Symbols name). Unset: the glyph of the file's type -- from mime-type, else from the name's extension (PDF, a sheet, slides, an archive, ... each its own; decision C81), else description.

href.description: The file's address: the name is a link to it (decision C51; it downloads in the same tab, or opens in target when download is false) and the download action fetches it. Empty: the name is text and the download action does nothing.

kind.description: What the preview shows: an icon, the image itself, or whichever suits the file.

mime-type.description: The file's MIME type, which helps kind="auto" tell an image from another file.

image-url.description: A picture to show in the holder for an image (kind image or auto): the thumbnail's address; empty uses href.

surface.description: Draws the row on a fill, as a block of its own: the size 3 control height around the holder (56 on a desktop, 52 on a phone).

download.description: true (the default): the download action saves the file under file-name, in the same tab. false: it opens the file instead, in target -- the same tab unless a target is given (C25).

target.description: Where an opened file goes when download is false and where the name link goes: empty (the default) is the same tab, as C25 asks for a file link; _blank opens a new tab and the action shows the new-tab sign.

actions.description: Shows the action buttons at the row's end (download and remove, as download-action and remove-action allow).

download-action.description: Shows the download action among the actions.

remove-action.description: Shows the remove action among the actions; it asks the page to detach the file (the detach event).

disabled.description: Makes the row unavailable: the actions do nothing and the row takes the disabled look.

state.description: The file's state, as the upload core's rows (decision C81). ready: the file is there -- the name is its link, the size under it, download and remove. uploading: the name as text, under it the upload row's bar with its per cent at the end (value; no value: the bar runs), aria-busy; remove stays (the host cancels), download is not offered. error: the name as text, under it «Не загрузился» and error-text in the error colour, «Повторить» (the retry event) at the end of the row -- under the text in a narrow row, where decision C88 places it -- and remove.

value.description: While uploading: the share sent, per cent (0 to 100, clamped), drawn by the bar and its per cent. Absent: the bar runs without a share.

error-text.description: Why the file did not upload, after «Не загрузился:» in a failed row (state error).

download-label.description: Empty: the text of the page's language with the file's name («Скачать Отчёт.pdf», "Download Report.pdf" in English; decision C51).

remove-label.description: Empty: the text of the page's language with the file's name («Удалить Отчёт.pdf», "Remove Report.pdf" in English; decision C51).

compact.description: Only the leading visual, as tall as a list row's line: the image, or the file's extension in a tile. For a file in a table cell.

aria-label.description: Empty: the text of the page's language ("File" in English).

size.description: Legacy name for file-size: the file's own size as text ("12 KB"), not the size ladder. Still honoured; pass file-size.

type.description: Legacy name for kind, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

getValue.summary: Return the current file identity and presentation value.

setOpen.summary: Legacy compatibility setter; actions remain visible.

toggleOpen.summary: Legacy compatibility toggle; actions remain visible.

sf-file-preview-retry.summary: A person pressed «Повторить» in a row that did not upload (vocabulary §5 retry): the host sends the file again and sets state.

sf-file-preview:download.summary: A download action was requested. Bubbles, is composed and is cancelable: preventDefault() stops the built-in navigation to href.

value.description: getValue(): fileName, fileSize, icon, href, type, mimeType, imageUrl, target.

sf-file-preview:remove.summary: A remove action was requested. Bubbles, is composed and is cancelable; the component removes nothing itself.

value.description: getValue(): fileName, fileSize, icon, href, type, mimeType, imageUrl, target.

accessibility.focus: Native file actions own focus-visible presentation.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-file-preview for an already selected or attached file with visible metadata and optional native actions.
do_not: Do not use it for upload progress or transport
Do not hide actions in a hover-only or floating layer
